blocks.text: You can revoke the access tokens assigned to the API clients, when required. The revoked access token can no longer be used to access the Zscaler API resources.
You can only revoke active tokens.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > API > Tokens.
On the Authentication Service Issued Tokens page, search or use the Status filter to view the list of active tokens.
Click Revoke for the specific active token.
In the Revoke Token window, enter CONFIRM to confirm the action, then click Revoke.
The token is revoked, and it can no longer be used to access the Zscaler API resources. You need to generate a new token when required.
